descriptionChirho: Used substantivally to denote a person who is unknown, unrecognized, or outside the in-group, as opposed to those who belong (Matt 17:25-26 outsiders vs. sons; John 10:5 the stranger vs. the shepherd).

labelChirho: belonging to another, not one's own
descriptionChirho: Attributive adjective describing something that pertains to or is the property of a different person, covering another's servant, foundation, labors, sins, possessions, or blood (Rom 14:4; 15:20; 2 Cor 10:15-16; 1 Tim 5:22; Luke 16:12; Heb 9:25).

labelChirho: foreign, of another nation or land
descriptionChirho: Denotes geographic or national foreignness, applied to lands where one sojourns as an alien and to the armies of foreign peoples (Acts 7:6; Heb 11:9, 34).
